family.description: This is the conserved N-terminal domain of ATPase family AAA domain-containing protein 3 (ATAD3) which is involved in dimerisation [[cite:PUB00097486]] and interacts with the inner surface of the outer mitochondrial membrane [[cite:PUB00089261]]. This domain is found associated with the AAA ATPase domain ([pfam:PF00004]). ATAD3 is essential for mitochondrial network organisation, mitochondrial metabolism and cell growth at organism and cellular level. It may also play an important role in mitochondrial protein synthesis.
family.name: ATPase family AAA domain-containing protein 3, N-terminal
